assignment_rule: Assignments must be target-blind, semantic-behavior labels frozen before atlas outcomes, and must define genuinely interchangeable prompts rather than merely sharing a benchmark split.
current_reason: The eight ARC groups contain heterogeneous questions and have no sealed interchangeable-behavior family assignments. Easy versus Challenge is a difficulty/source label, not a behavior-family equivalence relation.
decision_effect: G1_atlas cannot fully pass and the recursive experiment remains blocked until a versioned fresh prompt-family artifact satisfies every numeric floor.

prompt_scale_definition.A_hat_p: Mean canonical response operator across the registered independent replica/checkpoint cells for prompt p.
prompt_scale_definition.A_bar_b_p: Leave-one-prompt-out mean of A_hat_q over all q in the frozen behavior family b(p), q != p.
prompt_scale_definition.prose: Take the 95th percentile over prompts of the largest eigenvalue of the squared within-family prompt deviation.
